[#hash-backends-of-blake2-mac]
.Who implements `macs::blake2b_mac`, `macs::blake2s_mac` (RFC 7693, keyed (section 2.5))

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man3/EVP_MAC.pod, doc/man7/EVP_MAC-HMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-KMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-BLAKE2.pod, EVP_MAC-Siphash.pod and providers/implementations/macs/ state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `macs::blake2b_mac`: `sodium` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `macs::blake2s_mac`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
